description:
What the bridge measured after a place request.

A placement the entity kept moving after (falling, pushed out of geometry) is reported as
placed with the measured `moved_during_settle`; the caller decides what that means. A placement
that could not run is `placed` false with a reason and no invented measurement: an unmeasured
position stays null, never zero.

game_s.description: Game clock; null when no game is running
game_s.title: Game S

moved_during_settle.description: Distance from the requested position after settle; null when it was not measured
moved_during_settle.title: Moved During Settle

position_after_settle.description: Measured position after the settle wait; null when the place did not run
position_after_settle.title: Position After Settle

reason.description: Why the place did not run; null when placed
reason.title: Reason

title: PlaceResult
